properties.name: resurs.scoring.solidity.reject
properties.description: Solidity (equity / total capital) below which the application is hard-rejected.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.solidity.flag
properties.description: Solidity below which the application is flagged for review.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.solidity.good
properties.description: Solidity at or above which the metric is considered good.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.liquidity.reject
properties.description: Liquidity (current assets / current liabilities) below which the application is flagged (soft reject).

properties.name: resurs.scoring.liquidity.flag
properties.description: Liquidity at or above which is considered the strong/good threshold.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.liquidity.good
properties.description: Alias for the liquidity good threshold.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.liquidity.marginal
properties.description: Upper bound of the liquidity 'near the limit' band (reject < liquidity < marginal) that is flagged.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.debt-ratio.reject
properties.description: Debt ratio (total liabilities / equity) above which the application is hard-rejected.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.debt-ratio.flag
properties.description: Debt ratio above which the application is flagged for review.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.debt-ratio.good
properties.description: Alias for the debt ratio good threshold.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.profit-margin.reject
properties.description: Profit margin (operating income / net revenue) below which the application is flagged as low.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.profit-margin.flag
properties.description: Alias for the profit margin low/warning threshold.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.profit-margin.good
properties.description: Profit margin above which the metric is considered good.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.cash-flow.reject
properties.description: Cash-flow ratio (operating cash flow / total liabilities) below which the application is hard-rejected (negative operating cash flow).

properties.name: resurs.scoring.cash-flow.flag
properties.description: Cash-flow ratio below which the application is flagged for review.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.cash-flow.good
properties.description: Alias for the cash-flow good threshold.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.interest-coverage.reject
properties.description: Interest coverage (operating income / interest expenses) below which the application is hard-rejected.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.interest-coverage.flag
properties.description: Interest coverage below which the application is flagged for review.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.interest-coverage.good
properties.description: Alias for the interest coverage good threshold.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.large-credit-threshold
properties.description: Requested amount (kr) above which the application is flagged as a large credit requiring manual review.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.large-credit-with-low-solvency
properties.description: Requested amount (kr) that, combined with solvency below low-solvency-threshold, triggers an additional flag.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.low-solvency-threshold
properties.description: Solvency below which, combined with a large credit amount, triggers an additional flag.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.high-debt-to-revenue-multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier of net revenue beyond which total liabilities trigger a flag.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.low-revenue-threshold
properties.description: Net revenue (kr) below which the company is flagged as small.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.negative-equity-threshold
properties.description: Equity below which the application is hard-rejected.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.negative-income-threshold
properties.description: Operating income below which the application is flagged.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.extra.negative-investing-ratio
properties.description: Magnitude of negative investing cash flow relative to net revenue that triggers a flag.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.combination.credit-vs-revenue-minimum
properties.description: Requested amount as a multiple of net revenue above which the combination is flagged.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.combination.equity-vs-credit-ratio
properties.description: Equity to requested-amount ratio below which the combination is flagged.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.combination.debt-burden-vs-revenue-threshold
properties.description: Debt-burden-to-revenue ratio above which the combination is flagged.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.review-flag-threshold
properties.description: Flag count from which a manual review is forced; any flag still triggers a review.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.industry-factors
properties.description: Industry correction multipliers keyed by industry code.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.industry-averages.solidity
properties.description: Average solvency per industry, used for industry-benchmark comparison.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.industry-averages.debt-ratio
properties.description: Average debt ratio per industry, used for industry-benchmark comparison.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.industry-averages.margin
properties.description: Average profit margin per industry, used for industry-benchmark comparison.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.industry-averages.solidity-comparison-ratio
properties.description: Fraction of the industry solvency average below which the applicant is flagged.

properties.name: resurs.scoring.industry-averages.margin-comparison-ratio
properties.description: Fraction of the industry margin average below which the applicant is flagged.
